meta.description: Comprehensibility ratings and comprehension scores for matched Dutch and German sentences whose clause-final verb clusters hold one to four verbs, Dutch in the crossed order and German in the nested order, against right-branching Paraphrase sentences expressing the same propositions. A Level-n Test sentence has an n-verb cluster. Three groups of 30 subjects heard the sentences, rated each on a 9-point scale from 1 (easy) to 9 (difficult), and after two-thirds of the Level 2 and Level 3 Test and Paraphrase sentences answered a question asking what one of the noun phrases did, scored 2 for naming the verb and its object, 1 for one of the two.
